title: VS Code extension is missing or different in Cursor's extension search
symptoms: A Microsoft Marketplace extension cannot be found in Cursor
The same publisher.extension ID installs different code than in VS Code
An Anysphere build appears in place of the familiar extension
cause: Cursor installs third-party extensions from Open VSX through its own proxy, not from the Microsoft Marketplace. Some Marketplace-only extensions are absent or replaced by Anysphere builds, and an ID can belong to a different publisher on Open VSX.
fix: Check the publisher before installing, prefer the Anysphere replacement where one exists, and restrict team installs to approved publishers or IDs.
apply: https://cursor.com/dashboard/team-settings   # Allowed extensions, or MDM policy key AllowedExtensions
